items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: Charlie Graham Williams(?), he was (?) when he lost that tape that I made by myself with the five trumpets on it.

ctx.x: Tony copied them. I don't know what happened to them after that. And somebody's liable to get them off him. Like they got some of the other things off him, you know. Charlie Graham Williams(?), he was (?) when he lost that tape that I made by myself with the five trumpets on it. I can't see how he could have did that. I can't see it.
